_comment: Fixture of the expected migration_options structure. execution_mode=imported: it does NOT come from a live Bob run. No numeric figures in pros/cons.

migration_options.name: Incremental Strangler Fig by endpoint
pros: Low operational risk: the monolith keeps running while endpoints are migrated one by one
Continuous validation through a golden-master characterization test suite
cons: Requires keeping a temporary routing facade during the transition
Two stacks coexist temporarily until the migration is complete

migration_options.name: Full monolithic rewrite (Big Bang)
pros: Removes all the legacy code at once
Immediate technology homogeneity with no routing facade
cons: Critical risk of failure: historically most big-bang projects suffer severe cost overruns
A long dark period with no production releases
Extreme difficulty verifying the semantic equivalence of every rule at the same time

migration_options.name: Extraction of the transactional core
pros: Goes straight at the complexity of the most critical domain logic
cons: High circular coupling between modules makes the first cut harder
Requires stabilizing the data contracts before migrating the presentation layer
